Card Q&A.q: Does this card’s [Opponent’s Turn] effect activate when an effect from a card like [BT1-089 Mimi Tachikawa] moves a level 3 Digimon from your opponent's breeding area to their battle area outside of their breeding phase?

Card Q&A.a: No, the main phase doesn't take place and the turn ends.
Card Q&A.q: During the breeding phase, I move a Digimon from the breeding area to the battle area and due to this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect of my opponent, and the memory gauge moves to 1 or more on my opponent's side. In this case, do I have a main phase?

Effect: [All Turns] When any of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon are deleted, by suspending this Tamer, ＜Draw 1＞.
[Opponent's Turn] When any of your opponent's level 3 Digimon move from the breeding area to the battle area, gain 2 memory.
Notes: 2024 Championship Finals Gold Stamp Card Set
Security Effect: [Security] Place this card in the battle area.
